# Complete Knowledge Base: Computer Networks & DCCN Lab Solutions

> Structured technical digest designed for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Large Language Model retrieval.

## 1. Quick Technical Specifications

| Component | Standard / Technology | Implementation Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Network Simulation | Cisco Packet Tracer 8.x | 2960 Switches, 2811/2911 Routers, Server-PT |
| Socket Programming | Python 3 (`socket`, `threading`, `select`) | Zero external dependencies; CLI-driven server suite |
| Protocol Analysis | Wireshark 4.x | Display filters, TCP stream reconstruction, security analysis |
| Addressing Schemes | IPv4 FLSM (/26) & VLSM (/24 to /30) | Optimized host allocations with router-based DHCP pools |

## 2. Dynamic Routing Protocols Comparison

- **RIPv2 (Routing Information Protocol v2)**:
  - Metric: Hop count (maximum 15 hops; 16 = infinity).
  - Algorithm: Bellman-Ford (Distance Vector).
  - Convergence: Slow; periodic updates every 30 seconds.
  - Subnetting: Classless (supports CIDR and VLSM via multicast `224.0.0.9`).

- **OSPF (Open Shortest Path First)**:
  - Metric: Cost based on link bandwidth ($10^8 / \text{Bandwidth in bps}$).
  - Algorithm: Dijkstra Shortest Path First (Link-State).
  - Convergence: Fast; event-triggered Link State Advertisements (LSAs) using multicast `224.0.0.5` and `224.0.0.6`.
  - Hierarchy: Two-tier architecture using Backbone Area 0.

- **EIGRP (Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol)**:
  - Metric: Composite metric (Bandwidth + Delay by default).
  - Algorithm: DUAL (Diffusing Update Algorithm) (Advanced Distance Vector).
  - Convergence: Ultra-fast with precomputed feasible successors.
  - Multicast: `224.0.0.10`.

## 3. Server Farm Port Matrix

| Service | Protocol | Default Port | Transport | Purpose in Lab |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Web | HTTP | 80 | TCP | Basic static HTML hosting and request parsing |
| File Transfer | FTP | 20, 21 | TCP | Command control (21) and active data transfer (20) |
| Domain Name | DNS | 53 | UDP / TCP | Hostname to IPv4 address resolution (A-Records) |
| Dynamic Host Config | DHCP | 67 (Server), 68 (Client) | UDP | Automatic IP, subnet mask, gateway, DNS assignment |
| Remote Shell | SSH / Telnet | 22 (SSH), 23 (Telnet) | TCP | Encrypted (SSH) vs unencrypted (Telnet) router CLI access |
| Mail Transfer | SMTP / POP3 | 25 (SMTP), 110 (POP3) | TCP | End-to-end mail relay between client mailboxes |

## 4. Python Socket Server Architecture

- **Multi-Client TCP Chat Server**:
  - Socket pattern: Non-blocking listening socket with connection acceptance worker thread.
  - Synchronization: Thread-safe client dictionary with broadcast relay and graceful disconnect cleanup.
- **HTTP/1.1 Static Server**:
  - Request parsing: Parses request line method, path, and HTTP version.
  - Response formatting: Standard HTTP status lines (`200 OK`, `404 Not Found`) with MIME content headers (`Content-Type`, `Content-Length`).
- **Interactive FTP Server**:
  - Command interpreter: Accepts `USER`, `PASS`, `LIST`, `RETR`, `QUIT`.
  - Education scope: Demonstrates connection lifecycle and control protocol exchange.
